payload.reason: The evidence indicates that not applying RR-based fingerprint construction can lead to overfitting and reduced generalisability, which negatively impacts the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR).

claims.text: Not applying RR-based fingerprint construction can lead to overfitting, which decreases the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and predictive value.
Regularisation in RR improves the SNR by reducing variability and enhancing the predictive value of the model.
